product.title: Chichen Itza, Cenote & Valladolid Tour with Tequila and Lunch

description.text: In Cancun, journey to Mexico's Yucatán Peninsula to visit the Mayan ruins of Chichen Itza on this full-day tour and experience this incredible archeological site with a local guide. Walk along El Castillo and the Pyramid of Kukulcan and learn how this pre-Columbian city played an important role in the Mayan Civilization. Stops include Chichen Itza, Cenote Chichikan, Valladolid. Midway through the day, enjoy a typical buffet lunch and a refreshing dip at a cenote. Ideal for visitors basing in Cancun who want a guided city experience without coordinating bus and walking routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Chichen Itza, Cenote Chichikan, Valladolid that define this Cancun sightseeing experience, with a guide handling hotel pickup, ruin tickets, and cenote or island pacing so the day stays focused on the outing rather than logistics.

highlights: Visit to Chichén Itzá, Cenote, and Valladolid with free time
